title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill x2 Caramel Coffee 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy’s Seriously Pod Fill x2 Caramel Coffee is a rich and indulgent blend that brings together the deep, roasted notes of freshly brewed Coffee with the smooth, buttery sweetness of Caramel. The bold espresso-like Coffee base delivers a robust depth, while the Caramel adds a mellow, golden sweetness that lingers on the exhale. This well-balanced vape provides a comforting and satisfying experience, perfect for those who enjoy dessert-inspired flavours. With a 50% VG / 50% PG formulation, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Doozy is a leading UK e-liquid brand known for its diverse flavour profiles and high-quality formulations. The Seriously Pod Fill x2 range is specially crafted for MTL vapers, offering full flavour with a refined throat hit in a versatile 50/50 blend.
